svg.text: Wet bin 10000 bu | Grain leg 3000 bu/h | Dryer D(M) = 2600 - 100M bu/h
Field moisture U(18%, 22%), seed 42 | Trips use each field's one-way travel time + 20 min nominal full-load unload (longer under backpressure) + equal return time
STOP after 6 eligibility-clock h; minimum 6 h | Predictive rolling horizon: 48 h
Horizontal axes: time (h). Dashed vertical line: harvest complete; drying may continue afterward.
